text:
I checked the fold-2 proposal. The text-check script came back clean, but two paragraphs still read too heavily for the owner.

I sent mastermind-fold-2 a rewrite and logged a "sent" line in `flags.jsonl`:
- **Name collisions item:** it runs over 60 words, so I rewrote it as a three-item checklist.
- **Pluggable item:** I split it into two bullets and asked for links on the module and file names it mentions, such as `Plugin.js` and `Page.class.js`. I also asked them to define "mixin" once, where it first appears.

I did not edit `requirements.md` myself because its owner is still running.

I wrote the review report with verdict `fix`; the visual systems are unreviewed because the shots are unusable. All four shots are Chrome "This site can't be reached" error pages, so layout, sizing, wrapping, spacing and colour are marked "not measured". The findings come from reading the diff and the docs.

The four `[fix]` findings:
1. **Plugin store and host list:** `store` and `hosts` became separate statics for each `Pluggable(...)` host. `core/Plugin/page.js:6,151` still reads only `Plugin.store` and `Plugin.hosts`, so Page's plugin switches aren't saved and Page doesn't show on the Plugin page.
2. **Stale docs:** `core/Plugin/doc/design-notes.md` (lines 22 and 31) still says `Page.use` is not migrated. `core/Page/doc/classes.md` still says `Page extends Item`.
3. **Inbox comments:** the comments at `Inbox.js:129` and `:144` were not touched or noted as checked.
4. **Task folder:** it isn't continuable on its own. There is no collision-overlap log and no before/after test-count file; the counts and smoke result exist only as log lines in `session.jsonl`.

The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-live-page/live-plan/fold-2/review/report.md`. I made no code edits.
